name: cashflow
description: Buy now, pay later for small business rent. Open source reference implementation, mock money only.

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm --filter @cashflow/api db:migrate && pnpm --filter @cashflow/api db:seed
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm --filter @cashflow/api db:migrate && pnpm --filter @cashflow/api db:seed
